examples.name: No results (informative)
examples.description: A self-contained empty state on a sunken surface panel, with two actions.
examples.jsx: <EmptyState type="informative" illustration={<Illustration />} heading="No results found" actions={<ButtonGroup><Button appearance="subtle">Clear filters</Button><Button appearance="primary">New search</Button></ButtonGroup>}>Try adjusting your search or filters.</EmptyState>

props.heading: No results found
props.children: Try adjusting your search or filters.

examples.name: Description only
examples.description: The minimal form - just the required description.

examples.name: First run with a primary action
examples.description: An empty state that invites the user to create their first item.
examples.jsx: <EmptyState illustration={<Illustration />} heading="Your inbox is empty" actions={<Button appearance="primary">Compose</Button>}>New messages will appear here.</EmptyState>

antiExamples.name: Error state
antiExamples.reason: Use SectionMessage or Banner with the error appearance for a failure, not Empty State.
antiExamples.jsx: <EmptyState heading="Something went wrong">We couldn't load your matters.</EmptyState>

antiExamples.name: Loading placeholder
antiExamples.reason: Use Skeleton or Spinner while content loads, not an Empty State.

antiExamples.name: Overloaded actions
antiExamples.reason: Keep Empty State to one primary and at most one secondary action.
